snapshot_binding.limitation: The historical root is retained only as a provenance exclusion; no metric value was copied from historical audit artifacts.

codegraph.query: current working-tree structural provenance: C# declared types, project references, namespace references, type references, dependency graph and SCC/cycles. Provide index status/staleness and what complete graph/SCC computation is or is not exposed.
codegraph.result: Returned current verbatim source for a limited set of symbols/files and blast-radius information; it did not expose a complete graph or a sound SCC computation.
codegraph.use: Structural provenance only; no Codegraph aggregate count is represented as a complete compiler-semantic fact.

tracked.definition: Paths reported by git ls-files -- '*.cs'; this is a Git-index scope, not an on-disk filtered-source scope.

raw.definition: Every present on-disk *.cs file recursively enumerated beneath D:/IA/ace v.2 before segment filtering, including generated and orchestration evidence files.

filtered.definition: Present on-disk *.cs files under the working tree whose normalized relative path contains none of the excluded segments. Production and test source are both included; this receipt does not assert a production-only count.

exclusions.path_match_rule: Split each normalized relative path on '/'; exclude when any segment equals one of excluded_segments. This prevents substring false positives such as an ordinary filename containing 'obj'.
exclusions.generated_csharp_rule: Any *.cs below an excluded generated-output segment is excluded; additionally, generated C# is not claimed as source when it is materialized under bin, obj, runtime/runtimes, or generated.
exclusions.phase0_dossier_rule: docs/architecture-migration is Phase 0 evidence/dossier content, not application source; it contained no *.cs file in this capture and therefore did not change the filtered count.
exclusions.installer_output_rule: installer is excluded as an installer-output segment; publish is excluded as publish output.

methodology.enumeration_and_text_metrics_powershell: $root=(git rev-parse --show-toplevel).Replace('\','/'); $excludedSegments=@('.git','.codegraph','.omo','bin','obj','publish','installer','runtimes','runtime','generated'); function Test-Excluded([string]$relativePath) { $segments=$relativePath.Replace('\','/').Split('/'); return @($segments | Where-Object { $excludedSegments -contains $_ }).Count -gt 0 }; $allCs=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -Recurse -File -Filter *.cs -Force | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Substring($root.Length).TrimStart([char[]]@('\','/')).Replace('\','/') }); $filteredCs=@($allCs | Where-Object { -not (Test-Excluded $_) }); $trackedCs=@(git ls-files -- '*.cs'); $physicalLoc=($filteredCs | ForEach-Object { [System.IO.File]::ReadLines((Join-Path $root $_)).Count } | Measure-Object -Sum).Sum; $nonblankLoc=($filteredCs | ForEach-Object { @([System.IO.File]::ReadLines((Join-Path $root $_)) | Where-Object { $_.Trim().Length -gt 0 }).Count } | Measure-Object -Sum).Sum; $joined=[string]::Join([Environment]::NewLine,@($filteredCs | ForEach-Object { Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root $_) -Raw })); $projectFiles=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -Recurse -File -Filter *.csproj -Force | Where-Object { -not (Test-Excluded $_.FullName.Substring($root.Length).TrimStart([char[]]@('\','/')).Replace('\','/')) }); [pscustomobject]@{raw_cs_files=$allCs.Count;filtered_cs_files=$filteredCs.Count;tracked_cs_files=$trackedCs.Count;physical_loc=$physicalLoc;nonblank_loc=$nonblankLoc;declared_type_matches=[regex]::Matches($joined,'(?m)^\s*(?:\[[^\]]+\]\s*)*(?:(?:public|internal|protected|private)\s+)?(?:(?:abstract|sealed|static|partial|readonly|ref)\s+)*(?:class|interface|struct|record(?:\s+(?:class|struct))?|enum|delegate)\s+[@A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*').Count;project_reference_matches=[regex]::Matches([string]::Join([Environment]::NewLine,@($projectFiles | ForEach-Object { Get-Content -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Raw })),'<ProjectReference\b').Count;namespace_declaration_matches=[regex]::Matches($joined,'(?m)^\s*namespace\s+[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.]*').Count;using_namespace_directive_matches=[regex]::Matches($joined,'(?m)^\s*(?:global\s+)?using\s+(?:static\s+)?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.]*\s*;').Count;type_reference_token_matches=[regex]::Matches($joined,'\b[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]*\b').Count} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3
methodology.project_provenance: Read-only inspection of SnowMeltingCalculator.sln identifies two solution projects. The ProjectReference metric is a textual scan of filtered .csproj files, not a resolved MSBuild graph.
methodology.scc_provenance: Codegraph query above was the available indexed structural method. It did not return a complete directed dependency graph or SCC result; no substitute SCC algorithm was run against lexical using/type matches.

metrics.limitations: Includes tracked generated files if any and can include a path absent from the current working tree; do not compare directly to filtered on-disk scope as an equivalence claim.

metrics.method: PowerShell recursive on-disk *.cs enumeration before exclusions
metrics.limitations: Includes .omo evidence and generated obj files; it is intentionally unfiltered.
This is a file-path classification, not a compiler assessment of generated provenance.

metrics.method: PowerShell recursive enumeration plus exact segment predicate
metrics.limitations: Includes both src and tests; excludes all matching segments regardless of Git tracking state.
Physical lines include comments, directives, braces, and blank lines.
Nonblank is textual and does not distinguish comments from executable code.
Lexical approximation only: may miss unusual declaration forms and is not a Roslyn/compiler-semantic declared-type count.

metrics.method: Regex count of <ProjectReference\b in filtered project files
metrics.limitations: Textual MSBuild-item count, not evaluated project graph or transitive-reference count.
Textual declaration occurrences, not distinct namespaces and not compiler-bound symbols.

metrics.method: Regex count of ordinary/global/static using namespace directives
metrics.limitations: Textual directives, not resolved namespace-reference edges; aliases and unresolved directives do not prove dependencies.

metrics.method: Regex count of PascalCase-like identifier tokens
metrics.limitations: Lexical token approximation, not a distinct or resolved type-reference count; it includes declarations, member names, framework identifiers, and text-like identifiers.

metrics.scope: complete current working-tree directed dependency graph
metrics.method: No sound complete SCC method available from the queried Codegraph surface
metrics.limitations: Codegraph returned limited source and blast radius but no complete graph/SCC result. SCCs were not inferred from using counts or lexical type tokens.

metrics.scope: complete current working-tree directed dependency graph
metrics.limitations: A cycle count requires an explicitly defined complete graph and sound SCC algorithm; neither was available without fabricating a graph from lexical references.
